Package neqsim.util.database

Class NeqSimDatabaseBase

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.database.NeqSimDatabaseBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, AutoCloseable, FileSystemSettings
Direct Known Subclasses:
NeqSimBlobDatabase, NeqSimDataBase, NeqSimExperimentDatabase, NeqSimFluidDataBase
public abstract class NeqSimDatabaseBase extends Object implements FileSystemSettings, Serializable, AutoCloseable
Shared JDBC lifecycle support for NeqSim database wrappers.

Subclasses provide the concrete connection strategy by implementing openConnection() and the class logger via getLogger().

June 2026
